verdict.rationale: Cake documents a separate My Cake Portal where investors see their own holdings and linked share certificates, with admins controlling what they can see. The 'structured updates' half rests only on a vague marketing line about communicating with investors during a capital raise. missing for 10: documented structured investor update or reporting feature (scheduled or templated updates), detail on investor-facing communication workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the investor portal experience.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table

citations.quote: the My Cake Portal where investors and employees view their individual holdings
As an admin, you control exactly what they can see, they do not have access to your full cap table.
Shareholders will be able to access linked certificates in their My Cake portal.
communicate with your investors, all in one platform
